Workspace: `C:\Vortex Services\go-lib` (Go 1.25). Modules: `./messaging/kafka/franzgo`, `./messaging/kafka/schemaregistry`. Root `AGENTS.md` sets defaults; module `AGENTS.md` overrides them. Always follow the module’s `AGENTS.md` when editing its files: `foundation/AGENTS.md`, `security/AGENTS.md`, `transport/AGENTS.md`, `data/AGENTS.md`, `runtime/AGENTS.md`, `messaging/AGENTS.md`.

Run checks per module, not `go test ./...` from workspace root:
```sh
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go build ./...)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go test -count=1 ./...)
(cd foundation && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd runtime && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd data && go test -count=1 -tags "unit testhooks" ./postgres)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go vet ./...)
```
Integration tests use Docker (Postgres, Redis, Redpanda). Run race checks in Docker using `golang:1.25.7` if local CGO toolchain unavailable.

Keep public API backward-compatible unless task explicitly requires breaking changes. Keep functions nil-safe at module boundaries where contexts/pointers may be nil. Prefer deterministic behavior and explicit validation errors. Do not add new external dependencies unless strictly required. If exported behavior changes, update relevant README files. Workflows are in `.github/workflows`; `integration-race.yml`. Any change to build/test process should update both this file and workflow definitions.
